DatacenterId.description: The ID of the data center.

Endpoints.description: Collection that identifies the service type and address for each endpoint of the organization.

FriendlyName.description: The friendly name of the organization.

Geo.description: A value that represents the geographic region the tenant is found in.

OrganizationId.description: The global unique identifier of the organization.

OrganizationType.description: Indicates the type of the organization.

SchemaType.description: Indicates the base schema the environment was provisioned with.

UniqueName.description: The unique name of the organization.

UrlName.description: The organization name used in the URL for the organization web service.
